name: Paper Costume Parade
description: Witness a tradition over 150 years in the making as hundreds of participants parade in elaborate costumes made entirely of paper. This year's 'Fables and Legends' theme promises a magical spectacle along the waterfront.
longDescription:
The Paper Costume Parade in Foz do Douro is an annual cultural event with a history spanning over 150 years. This tradition involves local community groups and individuals who dedicate months to crafting intricate costumes exclusively from paper. The parade serves as a celebration of creativity and a continuation of a long-standing local custom, culminating in a public display along the waterfront. For 2026, the chosen theme is 'Fables and Legends', guiding the design and narrative of the wearable paper art.

Attendees can expect to see hundreds of participants showcasing their elaborate paper creations. The event takes place outdoors along the Foz do Douro waterfront, providing a scenic backdrop for the procession. The atmosphere is generally festive and community-oriented, drawing a diverse audience of all ages. The parade typically lasts for several hours, allowing ample opportunity to observe the detailed craftsmanship of each costume.

Admission to the Paper Costume Parade is free, and no tickets are required; spectators are welcome to line the parade route. Foz do Douro is accessible by public transport, with several bus lines serving the area. Specific bus stops along the waterfront will be within walking distance of the parade route. The event is family-friendly.
